extracted.name: Easy Chicken Curry
extracted.description: Recipe video above. This is a Western style curry, and it's the easiest chicken curry I know how to make with the least ingredients possible without sacrificing tastiness! Very mild, not spicy at all (assuming curry powder is mild).
ingredient_lines: 270 ml / 1.25 cups coconut milk (, full fat (9 oz) (Note 3))
1.5 cups (375 ml) chicken stock low sodium
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook garlic, ginger and onion for 3 minutes until onion is translucent.
Add chicken and cook until it it changes from pink to white.
Add curry powder and cook for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk and chicken stock. Stir, lower heat to medium and cook, simmering rapidly, for 10 minutes until sauce reduces and thickens.
Add peas and salt. Cook for a further 2 minutes, then taste to see if it needs more salt. Garnish with coriander.
Serve over rice, noodles or mashed potato!
